technique_name: Identify a metaphor used in the given article.
description: The author of the article uses the metaphor of "floating on a wave" to describe the positive effects self-discipline can have on an individual. The metaphor implies that a wave can be powerful and unstoppable, but self-discipline can help steer the individual in a constructive direction even when faced with obstacles.
example: This is an article about the importance of self-discipline (https://www.psychologytoday.com/us/blog/chaos-and-control/201809/self-discipline).
